name: Gnoll-Blooded Tiefling (Packspawn Tiefling)
body:
Packspawn are a particularly brutal variety of tieflings often born to gnoll tribes that practice demon-worship. Unlike most tieflings who are treated as outcasts, packspawn are lauded as good omens and elevated to positions of leadership within the tribe, leading gnoll raiding parties. Most are driven by their desires to unleash pure destruction and bloodshed, and are almost uncontrollably filled with malice.

Ancestry Varies (usually demon).

Typical Alignment Chaotic Evil.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Str, +2 Con, –2 Int. This trait alters your ability scores and replaces fiendish sorcery.
Alternate Spell-Like Ability You gain tactical acumen as a spell-like ability.
Gnoll-Blooded You count as both a native outsider and a gnoll for any effects related to your species. This trait alters your type.
Natural Weaponry You gain a bite attack and two claw attacks. These are primary natural attacks that deal 1d4 points of damage each. This trait replaces skilled.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
